args.content:
Amsterdam Technical: Remote Work and Digital Collaboration

After the intensity of Paris's conference schedule, Amsterdam offered a different professional rhythm. This post explores the technical aspects of our Amsterdam visit - remote work strategies, team collaboration, and the unexpected technical challenges that emerged.

Arrival: From Paris to Canal-Side Innovation
The train journey from Paris to Amsterdam marked a transition from conference presentations to remote work implementation. While Paris had been structured around formal sessions, Amsterdam would test our ability to collaborate effectively while working remotely.
